messages:
owen: Quick follow-up from the postmortem. We need owners + firm dates for the SLO carve-out and recurrence-detection work (KVCache stalls).

priya: I will own the SLO change request. Drafting measurement queries now. Target: SLO ticket in 48h.

jess: I'll take dashboards & alerts. Will add per-route p95/p99, per-model tail, and an alert that fires if the same root_cause tag shows up 3x within 90d. ETA 48h.

owen: Runtime mitigations? Who's on adaptive throttling and batching tuning?

jess: Can prototype a recurrence counter on the dash that increments when postmortem tags match. Will add links to traces and runbook.

priya: Proposal: scoped SLO for "large-context" (ctx>2k or >5 turns) p95=250ms; default p95 stays 150ms. I'll include rationale and impact in the ticket.

owen: Good. On error budgets: recommend NOT resetting. Let the burn drive prioritization.

jess: Agree, no reset. Dash will show ongoing burn and a note about the temporary SLO exception window.

owen: For throttling, i'll prototype queue-length + kv-hit heuristic. Plan: staging repro today, PR in 4 business days.

alert-bot: Reminder set for 2026-04-06 09:00 UTC to review owners (priya, jess, owen).

priya: SLO ticket SLO-2026-900 created with queries and scoped-SLO text. Tagged product & reliability for sign-off.

jess: Dash ticket D-9001 created; panels staged and recurrence alert added (simulated test passed). Will promote after SLO sign-off.

owen: Summary owners/dates: priya (SLO ticket) - 48h, jess (dash+alerts) - 48h, owen (throttle prototype) - PR in 4bd. No error budget reset. Schedule 2-week follow-up to confirm recurrence suppression. Closing thread, update tickets as you make progress. Thanks :thumbsup:
